name: Live relay
description: Put a live stream on air through MetroS — MP3, AAC, HLS, Ogg or FLAC, transcoded as it arrives.

settingsSchema.label: Feed address
settingsSchema.help: An Icecast/Shoutcast stream, an HLS playlist (.m3u8), or a file on disk. MP3 is forwarded untouched; anything else is transcoded by MetroS.

settingsSchema.label: Artist on air
settingsSchema.help: Shown as the artist while the relay runs. Empty uses the plugin name.

settingsSchema.label: Reconnect when the feed drops
settingsSchema.help: A dropped feed on the internet is normal; this comes back five seconds later.

settingsSchema.label: Transcode bitrate
settingsSchema.help: Only used when the feed is not already MP3.

settingsSchema.label: Start with the node
settingsSchema.help: Put this feed on air as soon as the plugin loads.
